assertion: Approval Queue has a dedicated Compliance route
Queue is explicitly distinct from Inspection Review & Approval
Only compliance_admin and reviewer roles enter the route
Pending Review view reads only pending_review requests
Partially Approved view reads only partially_approved requests
Ready to Publish view reads only approved requests
Requests are ordered by submitted time without invented priority
Maker-owned requests are excluded from eligible workload
Database RPC independently denies maker decisions/publication
RLS remains the read authority
Cards show request number type revision status and correlation
Cards show current component decision progress
Cards show current dependency count
Review opens Current-versus-Proposed component comparison
Approve and Reject remain component-level guarded actions
Return and Reject comments remain required
Publication remains transactional and dependency guarded
Queue contains no direct DML or RPC decision bypass
Loading error empty and own-request states are honest
Existing Inspector inspection-review providers and history are unchanged
